title: Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox for Voice Dubbing and Full-Duplex Dialogue Synthesis
title_zh: 无需对齐的 Text-Audiobox：用于语音配音与全双工对话合成
abstract_en: We present Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox (Text-AB), a unified framework for high-quality voice dubbing and full-duplex dialogue synthesis. Building on a Diffusion Transformer trained with a flow-matching objective, Text-AB departs from the Audiobox system along three dimensions. First, it operates in a latent diffusion framework using DAC-VAE features that encode 48 kHz waveforms into a 25 Hz latent sequence, giving over 10x higher compression than previous EnCodec representations while improving resynthesis quality. Second, Text-AB is alignment-free: it consumes raw text via an off-the-shelf text encoder and learns text-speech alignment through cross-attention, removing the need for forced alignment and explicit duration prediction. Third, we scale model and data substantially, pretraining a 3B-parameter model on 480k hours of monolingual speech, followed by supervised fine-tuning on three downstream tasks: cross-lingual voice dubbing, full-duplex dialogue synthesis, and emotional full-duplex dialogue synthesis. At inference, Text-AB supports one-shot generation for up to ~1 min of speech and arbitrarily long-form generation via a multi-diffusion scheme, plus a multi-stage reranking strategy that enhances quality based on automated metrics. On a real-world dubbing benchmark, Text-AB delivers a step-change improvement over the latest internal dubbing system, with large gains in prosody similarity, voice similarity, naturalness, and shareability. For full-duplex dialogue synthesis, it approaches human recordings on short-form conversations and substantially outperforms the latest internal model on long-form human-likeness and expressivity, while natively modeling turn-taking, back-channeling, and emotional dynamics. For emotional dialogue synthesis, emotion conditioning significantly improves emotion alignment and emotional interaction quality over the unconditioned baseline.
abstract_zh: 本文提出统一框架 Text-Audiobox（Text-AB），面向高质量跨语言语音配音、全双工对话合成和情感对话合成。Text-AB 基于采用 flow-matching 目标训练的 Diffusion Transformer，并在三个方面改进 Audiobox：一是使用 DAC-VAE 将 48 kHz 波形压缩为 25 Hz latent 序列，相比 EnCodec 具有超过 10 倍的压缩率，同时提升重合成质量；二是采用 alignment-free 设计，直接输入原始文本，通过 cross-attention 学习文本与语音的对齐关系，无需 forced alignment 和显式时长预测；三是扩大模型与数据规模，使用 480,000 小时单语语音预训练 3B 参数模型，再针对跨语言语音配音、全双工对话合成和情感全双工对话合成进行 supervised fine-tuning。推理时，模型支持最长约 1 分钟语音的 one-shot generation，并通过 multi-diffusion 实现任意长度生成；结合基于自动指标的多阶段 reranking，可进一步提升生成质量。在真实配音基准上，Text-AB 在韵律相似度、音色相似度、自然度和可分享性方面均显著优于最新内部系统。在全双工对话合成中，模型在短对话上接近人类录音，在长对话的人类感、表现力方面显著领先，并能原生建模轮次切换、back-channeling 和情绪动态。情感条件控制还显著提升了情绪一致性与情感互动质量。
key_points_zh: 采用 DAC-VAE latent diffusion，将 48 kHz 音频编码为 25 Hz latent 序列，在高压缩率下提升重合成质量。
直接处理原始文本，通过 cross-attention 学习文本—语音对齐，免除 forced alignment 和显式时长预测。
基于 480,000 小时语音预训练 3B 参数 Diffusion Transformer，并覆盖配音、全双工及情感对话三类任务。
支持约 1 分钟语音的 one-shot generation、基于 multi-diffusion 的长文本生成，以及多阶段 reranking。
在配音和长篇全双工对话基准上显著提升相似度、自然度、人类感与表现力，并能建模轮次切换和情绪互动。

llm_assessment.comment: A technically substantial speech-generation system with meaningful full-duplex dialogue synthesis, but its primary contribution is dubbing and offline generation rather than interactive agent operation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作在语音生成和全双工对话合成方面技术贡献突出，但主要聚焦配音与离线生成，而非交互式代理运行。
